_about: Base arms for generate_delta.py (2026-09-27, replaces the provisional delta-on-A07 file). Every cell is built from the anchor's OWN generated arm config at the cell's seed, read from the sha-checked anchor bundle named in anchor_bundle (42abed4b since 2026-09-28) (member pattern below); nothing is re-derived. The config's own name / experiment.arm / campaign block are replaced by Delta identity and a delta_study provenance block. base_text_rules map an entry's free-text base[target] (delta.json) to an arm (first match wins; an unmatched text is an error). The stand-in section is kept ONLY to regenerate configs-standin/ for the tarball series' slug tests (tests_patches/slug_tests.py); stand-in configs are never packed.
